newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Albany cuts Davox.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Albany cuts Davox.

text.p: -- First Albany said it cut its rating on Davox Corp to neutral from buy.
-- First Albany said the firm re-evaluated its rating after Davox's share price surpassed the target price of $43 a share.
-- First Albany said it thought the recent increase in share price is "excessive."
-- "We recommend that investors wait for a price pullback before considering purchasing Davox shares," First Albany said.
-- On Tuesday, shares of Davox, which makes computer-aided communications systems, were down 1-3/4 to 41-1/2 in midafternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
